The '''1945–46 [[Italian Football Championship]]''' officially known as '''1945–46 [[Divisione Nazionale]]''', was the forty-fourth edition of the [[Italian Football Championship]]. It was the twenty-first season from which the Italian Football Champions adorned their team jerseys in the subsequent season with a [[Scudetto]]. 1945-46 was the first Italian Football Championship held after the ravages of [[World War II]]. Hence the authorities resurrected a one season return to the Divisione Nazionale two region set up, instead of the nationwide [[Serie A]] [[brand]] introduced in [[1929–30 Serie A|1929]].

[[Torino FC]] were champions for the third time in their [[history]]. This was their third scudetto since the scudetto started being awarded in [[1923–24 Prima Divisione|1924]] and their second 'non-Serie A' style win. This was their second of five consecutive Italian Football Championship wins, punctuated by a two-year break due to [[World War II]].

Just after the [[Allies of World War II|Allied]] disbandment of the fascist [[Direttorio Divisioni Superiori|Higher Directory]], the major clubs from [[United States|US]]-occupied [[Northern Italy]] replaced it by a provisional football league, the [[Lega Nazionale Alta Italia|High Italy League]] ''(Lega Alta Italia)'', which organized the local section of the [[Serie A]].

===Teams===
[[Modena FC|Modena]] and [[Brescia Calcio|Brescia]] had been promoted from [[Serie B]].

[[Sampdoria|Sampierdarenese]] and [[Sampdoria|Andrea Doria]] reborn from [[Sampdoria|Liguria]] and both joined this championship as [[FIGC]] special guests to repair their forced fusion by the [[Fascist Italy (1922–1943)|fascist]] government [[1926–27 Divisione Nazionale|in 1927]].

===Teams===
[[AS Bari|Bari]] had been relegated to [[Serie B]] but the [[FIGC]] annulled the move for wartime reasons.

===Serie B guests===
[[US Palermo|Palermo]] had been relegated to [[Serie C]] but the [[FIGC]] annulled the move for wartime reasons.

[[Salernitana]] had been promoted from [[Serie C]].

[[Pisa Calcio|Pisa]] was granted of a special break for its huge wartime damages. [[M.A.T.E.R.|MATER]] had been disbanded.
